contents.text: The runbook doesn't account for KeyNotFoundException, and the decisions table has rows that don't all point to the same outcome, so I need to look into that. I'll brief the investigator with the run ID, the error, and the runbook.

arguments.reason: The order-total runbook does not list KeyNotFoundException under Expected, and its Decisions table gives different outcomes depending on the finding (auto-fix or person), so the cause has to be investigated first. The error is a KeyNotFoundException for discount code SUMMER25 on order 1003, in Api/OrderTotal.cs line 18.

arguments.message:
Run id: eval-order-total-1003-20261127-053832-triage-1. Please investigate this error in the order-service repository at demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service.

Error: method order-total, argument 1003, System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException, message "The given key 'SUMMER25' was not present in the dictionary." Stack: OrderService.OrderApi.GetOrderTotal(Int32 id) in src/OrderService/Api/OrderTotal.cs:line 18, called from Program.cs:line 13.

Runbook for order-total: GET /orders/{id}/total returns the subtotal minus the order's discount code, rounded to 2 decimals (Api/OrderTotal.cs). Discount codes in force: WELCOME10 (10%), VIP20 (20%). Marketing retires codes without notice, so orders can carry a code no longer in the table. Expected (no action): OrderService.OrderNotFoundException only. Decisions: a crash in this method's code with a certain cause, e.g. a KeyNotFoundException for a retired discount code, gives auto-fix (coder). A fix that is not confirmed, that would change the total of an order with a valid code, or a cause that is not certain gives person (orders). Expected behaviour: an unknown or retired discount code gives no discount (total equals subtotal) instead of failing. Totals for orders with WELCOME10, VIP20 or no code must not change.

Please find where the cause is, what it is in one sentence, whose area it is (code, data, hosting, third-party or unknown), and how sure you are (low, medium, high). Report with ReportInvestigation. Do not change any code.
